failure_evidence.classification: Fixture driver waited until the correctly advanced short line was fully revealed; no Settings/F9 stage had executed. This is neither a proven production defect nor F9 acceptance.

review_findings.detail: Focus/window preparation occurs on completed saved A. Exactly one Enter press and release are injected through Input.parse_input_event plus flush, across process frames. The helper reads the canonical successor and InputManager neutrality, checks the real Pause admission capture, then dispatches one Escape press/release. It does not invoke advance/complete/restart methods, alter reveal fields, stretch text, or directly call request_pause.

capture_reading_checkpoint(false) selects capture_reading_frontier rather than reveal completion. capture_pause_source checks canonical session/route/frontier and gate admission; it does not acquire a Pause suspension. Physical Escape still reaches the production owner.

The generic 12-frame delay on the short B line is removed. Required release/neutral process frame remains; B is paused at first observed canonical/admitted frontier. Polls are bounded120 frames. The same strict partial reveal check still rejects a completed line rather than relabeling it.

settings-load-input.json retains four ordered key packets, process frames, contact counts and admitted canonical frontier. Advanced stage binds that record; Python verifies exact Enter press/release then Escape press/release, strictly increasing frames, one contact on each press and zero on release, empty final contacts and equality to the preserved B frontier.

Only two fixture/runner files differ from Focus1; every pre-existing GDScript function retains its line. No public GameState/SaveManager symbol declaration or existing scanned call line is changed by this repair. This supports adoption of already reviewed Focus1 generated inventories; final read-only broad cloud gate remains authoritative.

conclusion: No blocking source defect found. Proceed to the already-required broad cloud gate; no source reason to rerun unchanged focused suites separately. The timing repair itself remains runtime-unverified.
limitations: Godot InputEventKey injection is real engine input routing but not operating-system keyboard or hardware-device proof.
State-based prompt dispatch removes the demonstrated delay but does not establish cloud timing success before execution.
Rendered F9 Cancel/confirm stages did not run in Focus1; their acceptance remains pending.
